run_wav2vec_featurize: run the wav2vec_featurize script to pre-compute embeddings for a flashlight dataset using a pretrained model
create_pretrained_wav2vec_model: create a PretrainedWav2VecModel from a checkpoint file to extract feature and context vectors from audio
create_prediction_wrapper: create a Prediction wrapper to extract wav2vec embeddings from raw audio waveforms on GPU
write_h5_features: write audio feature embeddings to an HDF5 file in flashlight compatible format using H5Writer
embed_audio_dataset: embed an entire audio dataset split using EmbeddingDatasetWriter to pre-compute and store wav2vec features
